2981-4131-5660-6769.easyPrerequisites: Evolution Witness has a +1/+1 counter on it.
2981-4131-5660-6769.description:
Cast Basalt Monolith by paying its mana cost.
When Basalt Monolith enters, Surge Conductor triggers.
Holding priority, activate Basalt Monolith by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Megatog by sacrificing Basalt Monolith, giving Megatog +3/+3 until end of turn.
Resolve the Surge Conductor trigger, causing you to proliferate, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Basalt Monolith from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat

2638-3510-5929-6291.easyPrerequisites:
You can cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Saproling has been chosen with Leyline of Transformation.
2638-3510-5929-6291.description:
Cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Each creature or land that entered is a Saproling through Leyline of Transformation and a Forest in addition to its other types due to and Life and Limb, causing Tireless Tracker to trigger that many times.
Resolve a Tireless Tracker trigger, creating the stated artifact tokens plus at least one creature token through Stridehangar Automaton.
Repeat steps 2-3. Unless you have a way to remove one of the pieces, this will cause an infinite mandatory loop and draw the game.

3277-5478-5531-5694-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
3277-5478-5531-5694-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Izzet Chronarch and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Izzet Chronarch and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
Resolve the Izzet Chronarch trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
Repeat.
3277-5478-5531-5694-8110.notes:
If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Izzet Chronarch and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.
An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

280-1479-7889.description:
Play Golgari Rot Farm.
When Golgari Rot Farm enters the battlefield, it, Dancing from Dark to Dawn, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Dancing from Dark to Dawn trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Golgari Rot Farm from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Golgari Rot Farm enters the battlefield, it and Dancing from Dark to Dawn trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

101-676-1987.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
101-676-1987.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creature tokens.
101-676-1987.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Vampire Charmseeker.
When Vampire Charmseeker enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
101-676-1987.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

924-4149-4599-4785-4871.easyPrerequisites: Gravespawn Sovereign is untapped or you control another untapped Zombie.
924-4149-4599-4785-4871.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three additional creatures.
924-4149-4599-4785-4871.description:
Activate Phyrexian Ghoul by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phyrexian Ghoul ability, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat steps 1 through 3 two additional times.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Ghoulcaller Gisa by paying {B}, tapping it and sacrificing Phyrexian Ghoul.
When Phyrexian Ghoul dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Ghoulcaller Gisa ability, creating eight 2/2 Zombie creature tokens.
Activate Gravespawn Sovereign by tapping five Zombies, returning Phyrexian Ghoul from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Phyrexian Ghoul by sacrificing Ghoulcaller Gisa.
When Ghoulcaller Gisa dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phyrexian Ghoul ability, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Activate Gravespawn Sovereign by tapping five Zombies, returning Ghoulcaller Gisa from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
924-4149-4599-4785-4871.notes: If Phyrexian Ghoul starts with a power of 4 or greater, you can reduce the number of additional creatures you control. It must get to 8 or higher power before sacrificing it to Gisa.

3490-4779-5445-7426.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
3490-4779-5445-7426.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing another artifact
Tarrian's Soulcleaver triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta and Animation Module trigger.
Resolve the Berta trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Repeat

2557-3129-4682-5140.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.
2557-3129-4682-5140.description:
Activate Kenrith's fourth ability by paying {3}{U}, causing an opponent who cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger to draw a card.
Smothering Tithe triggers, causing you to create four Treasure tokens due to Primal Vigor and Parallel Lives.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}.
Repeat.
2557-3129-4682-5140.notes: Eventually the opponent will lose the game due to drawing from an empty library. You can repeat this loop with other opponents that also cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.

2292-4677-7084.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Zendikar's Roil triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

671-3490-4017-4050.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
671-3490-4017-4050.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
When the Servo dies, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Sunbond attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

3661-3967-4053-6989.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Shield Sphere.
Cast Shield Sphere from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

3532-5078-5402-5645.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-5078-5402-5645.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Captain Storm.
Repeat.

643-3951-4772-5703.easyPrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr
643-3951-4772-5703.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker, triggering its ability, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it and creating two tapped and attacking copies of Éomer.
Put all but one Éomer token into your graveyard due to the legend rule, causing you to get at least one Éomer trigger, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, Altaïr triggers, causing you to exile the Éomer token.
Repeat each combat phase.

1445-2292-4871-5631.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-2292-4871-5631.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Skeleton Crew triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1350-1418-6470.description:
Cast Iridescent Tiger by paying {4}{R}.
When Iridescent Tiger enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, adding {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Iridescent Tiger from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

3090-5256-5434-5555.notablePrerequisites:
You control a face-down creature whose front face is a permanent card.
You have enough mana to cast Harmless Offering.
3090-5256-5434-5555.description:
Cast Harmless Offering by paying its mana cost, giving control of Karlov Watchdog to an opponent.
During the opponent's turn, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing a face-down creature you control.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat from step 2.

1737-2499-3094-4636.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {6} and tapping it.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Prototype Portal's ability.
Resolve the copy of Prototype Portal's ability, creating a token copy of Gonti's Aether Heart.
When the Gonti's Aether Heart token enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}.
Resolve the original Prototype Portal ability, creating a token copy of Gonti's Aether Heart.
Put either Gonti's Aether Heart token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Gonti's Aether Heart token enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}.
Activate the remaining Gonti's Aether Heart token by paying eight {E} and exiling it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1981-4591-5147.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1981-4591-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another creature, dealing 1 damage to you, with you being unable to lose the game due to Platinum Angel.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat.

1283-1939-2034-3615.description:
Cast Lunarch Veteran from your graveyard for its disturb cost by paying {2}, causing it to enter the battlefield transformed as Luminous Phantom.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Luminous Phantom, adding {2}.
Because Humility causes Luminous Phantom to lose all abilities, it is not exiled when it is sacrificed, and is returned to your graveyard as Lunarch Veteran.
Repeat.

409-957-4797.notablePrerequisites: Tormod's Cryptkeeper does not have summoning sickness.
409-957-4797.description:
Activate Tormod's Crpyt by tapping and sacrificing it, exiling your graveyard.
Cast Time Stretch by paying {8}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Deadbridge Chant triggers, returning Time Stretch to your hand from your graveyard.
Move to your next turn.
Repeat from step 2.
NOTE: This combo can fail if other cards enter your graveyard after step 1.

803-935-3809-4508.description:
Activate Niv-Mizzet by paying {U}{R}, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Malcolm and Niv-Mizzet trigger.
Resolve the Niv-Mizzet trigger, allowing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Malcolm trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}{U} or {R}{R}.
Repeat.

2292-2506-2721.description:
Cast Bloodline Necromancer by paying {4}{B}.
When Bloodline Necromancer enters the battlefield, it and Molten Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Bloodline Necromancer trigger, returning a Vampire or Wizard creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Bloodline Necromancer.
Resolve the Molten Echoes trigger, creating a token copy of Bloodline Necromancer with haste.
When the token Bloodline Necromancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning the nontoken Bloodline Necromancer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1215-2834-4659-4763.notablePrerequisites: Hero's Blade attached to Hope of Ghirapur.
1215-2834-4659-4763.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Hope of Ghirapur, adding {C}{C}.
Hope of Ghirapur dies, triggering Koll, returning Hope of Ghirapur from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Hope of Ghirapur by paying {1}.
Hope of Ghirapur enters the battlefield, triggering Hero's Blade, attaching Hero's Blade to Hope of Ghirapur.
Repeat.

1003-2816-4763-5147.description:
Equip Phyrexian Walker with Umbral Mantle.
Sacrifice Phyrexian Walker to Goblin Bombardment to deal 1 damage to any target.
Koll triggers, returning Phyrexian Walker to you hand.
Cast Phyrexian Walker.
Repeat.

1369-3812-3990.notablePrerequisites:
Quicksilver Elemental has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Quicksilver Elemental does not have summoning sickness.
1369-3812-3990.description:
Activate Quicksilver Elemental twice by paying {U}{U}, causing it to gain all activated abilities of Incubation Druid and Simic Ragworm until end of turn.
Activate Quicksilver Elemental using Incubation Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Quicksilver Elemental using Simic Ragworm's ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

651-2603-4943.description:
Activate Lancers en-Kor's by paying {0}, targeting Task Force.
Task Force triggers, giving itself +0/+3 until end of turn.
Resolve Lancers en-Kor's ability, causing the next one damage dealt to Lancers en-Kor this turn to be dealt to Task Force instead.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Cast Worthy Cause by paying {W} and sacrificing Task Force, causing you to gain life equal to Task Force's toughness.

739-2358-3350.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Axis of Mortality triggers.
Activate Blood Celebrant by paying {B} and one life, adding {B}.
Repeat step 2 until you have zero life.
Resolve the Axis of Mortality trigger, swapping your life total with an opponent.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero life.
You may repeat this on each of your turns.
